info.title: octoprint-upload
info.description: The routes octoprint-upload serves under its mount. Uploads do not come through here: the slicer talks to the module's own port, which serves OctoPrint's GET /api/version and POST /api/files/local.

get.summary: Whether the upload listener is serving
get.description: The port the upload API listens on, whether an API key is set, where uploads are stored, and the reason when the listener is not serving.

serving.description: Whether the upload API is listening.

problem.description: Why it is not serving, or empty.

slicer_host.description: The host address to give the slicer.
